ten_star_experience_contract.intent: NayaNET is an intelligent network, not a collection of attractive screens. 10/10 means an exceptional end-to-end experience for human users AND authorized Nayas, excellent design and true functionality, safe interconnection, and the maximum verified useful value per resource consumed.
ten_star_experience_contract.scope: Apply per human, Naya, page, Smart App, template, Space, system, task, and complete cross-room journey; component excellence alone cannot certify network excellence.
ten_star_experience_contract.objective: Maximize independently verified useful human/community outcome and intelligence reuse per authorized action, unit time, and compute cost, under hard harm, consent, privacy, identity, permission and reliability constraints.
ten_star_experience_contract.essential_human_test: A real permitted person understands the promise, succeeds at a useful task, knows current truth/proof, experiences exceptional accessible design, and can continue or recover with little unnecessary effort.
ten_star_experience_contract.essential_naya_test: A cold independently authenticated Naya can orient, retrieve applicable intelligence, understand LAW and scope, decide and execute one permitted valuable action, verify/recover and hand off without reconstructing chat.
ten_star_experience_contract.essential_network_test: One governed event appears as consistent permitted context across Dashboard, Project Intelligence, Space, Feed, Mail notification (when private-mail qualified), Reports, Library or applicable Rooms, without copies, leaks, stale status or false green.
ten_star_experience_contract.measurement: Record before/after human task completion, error/recovery, time/effort, actual useful outcome, Naya task/continuation, cost/latency, freshness, cross-room event integrity, and genuine user-reported experience. Idle polling, HTTP 200 and raw action count do not count as value.
hard_gates: Do No Harm; privacy, consent, LAW and verified human authority
Full legitimate human and Naya journeys, including adverse cases
Cross-room source consistency and failure recovery
Distinct independently authenticated PROVE/VERIFY evidence at exact deployed revision
Unmeasured or insufficiently evidenced = UNKNOWN; no averaging away a failing hard gate
ten_star_experience_contract.calibration: 10/10 is an evidence-backed acceptance against explicit tasks and known constraints, not a claim that future breakthroughs cannot improve the network.

north_star_operating_standard.scorecard_relationship: D1-D8 technical/visual criteria are supporting evidence only. The six North Star dimensions across all three levels evaluate real human and Naya value, execution and governance. They are non-substitutable.
rules: Do not certify a standalone page whose linked journey or network context fails
Do not certify a network from passing standalone component scores
All six dimensions must meet the ratified acceptance threshold separately at all three levels
Unmeasured user cohorts and external acceptance are UNKNOWN, never inferred from numeric author input
Never average away failure of governance, trust, safety, consent or real outcomes
seven_question_loop: What is its intended human and Naya value?
What is its measured performance and experience today?
What is the highest-leverage improvement, including a possible 10× gain?
Can the improvement be implemented safely and reused elsewhere?
Has an independent reviewer verified the actual result?
Did the improvement measurably increase value, reduce waste, or improve experience?
north_star_operating_standard.optimization: maximize independently verified beneficial outcomes, trustworthy collective intelligence and 10-star experience per justified action, time and resource under nonnegotiable safety and authority constraints
